name: 怪物塔 Monster Tower
detailed_description:
You will enter an endless monster tower, and you will have to defeat monsters and get equipment to equip yourself. You can also use various upgrade items to strengthen your weapons and challenge higher levels. The monster tower is full of dangers. If you die in it, you will lose all your equipment and items. But if you hold on, you can return to the base with rich loot and move to a higher level after you are ready. How many levels can you kill in this monster tower? Let's wait and see!

  • The player has only one pair of hands at the beginning. He enters an endless monster tower and equips himself by defeating monsters and exploding equipment. In addition to equipment, monsters will also drop various upgrade props, such as increasing the number of scattering, increasing the attack range, etc. Players can freely combine these characteristics to build customized weapons and build various different schools.

  • Once the player enters the monster tower, he must persist for a period of time before evacuating. If he dies in the tower, he will lose all his weapons and equipment and need to return to the base to equip himself from the warehouse and start again. If unfortunately there are no weapons in the warehouse, he will have to start again with one pair of hands. Fortunately, if the player can persist until the successful evacuation, he can bring all the weapons and equipment dropped in the game back to the base and store them in the warehouse to satisfy the hamster party~

  • The game is a classic vampire survivor gameplay. Players challenge the constantly refreshing enemies with their own customized weapons. Through customized powerful weapons, they experience the refreshing mowing gameplay, persist until the evacuation time, and evacuate with rich loot.

  • The monster tower is an endless tower. Every level you climb means stronger monsters, but it also means more loot. How many floors can you slaughter in this endless tower of monsters? Let's wait and see!
